integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. Warm work light grazes the plank walls of a narrow farm dairy. A shallow recess is cut into the stone counter. Its low front lip overhangs just the rear edge of the small four-tile floor. The tiles extend forward in an exposed strip wider than the hoop pair, with clear sightlines over the lip to both hoop bases. A high back rim hides the tiles from the dry gallery. A fixed brass tap feeds the open front half. One lamp shelf pivots on a hinge bolted to the back rim: two sealed battery hoops above, a broad clay heel underneath, a dry right handle and a high thumb switch. The raised shelf leans against a stop. One rectangular oak block sits on edge on the dry right sill in the path of the shelf corner. A closed ring box and a blank invoice share the ledge between JUCA and the groom. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. AT START: The hoop shelf is level on the stone sill and both upright hoops are dark. A water sheet borders the last dry tile corner. The oak block weighs down the blank invoice beside the open ring box. TEO is left, JUCA right, the groom upright between them and the tap shut. [Shot 1] Frontal wide. The advancing edge of the water sheet washes over the last dry corner. Above the four glossy tiles TEO turns a palm up under the fixed spout and JUCA brings his right thumb to the high switch. [Shot 2] At 00:02.600, the camera cuts to Low frontal three-shot, lens centered on the exposed tile strip beyond the lip with both upright hoops in frame. JUCA depresses the dry switch with his right thumb and both hoops light together. TEO sweeps his dry palm out from under the spout and bows to the groom. The groom lifts the open ring box with his left hand toward the lit pair. Below TEO's bow the water on that strip reflects both hoops in full, two unbroken loops trembling clear of the counter edge. [Shot 3] At 00:06.600, the camera cuts to Widen on the same low axis, keeping the lit pair and both complete reflections in frame. JUCA takes his thumb off the switch, pins the block with his left palm and slides the blank invoice clear with his right. He places it in the groom's open right hand and lets go. The groom raises slip and box side by side. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: Two lit hoops rise from the seated shelf and reflect in water covering all four tiles. TEO bows on the left with a dry palm; JUCA is empty-handed on the right. The groom holds the dry blank invoice in his right hand and the open ring box in his left. The oak block rests on the ledge and the tap is shut.
overall_soundscape: Water laps softly against the last ceramic corner; the plastic lamp switch clicks once under JUCA's thumb; the ring box base brushes the wooden ledge lightly on the lift; invoice paper rasps under oak as JUCA draws it clear; the dry slip rustles briefly in the groom's fingers.
non_diegetic_music: Clarinet and pizzicato cello finish the same quiet two-note cadence an octave apart.
